about: The LARRYD runtime's own config. It is air gapped: its ONLY link to the platform is HTTP to the addresses below, signed with the secret named here. No path, file, database or module of the platform is ever named.

platform.about: where the runtime calls the platform, per side (the platform's global_config offices)

callers.about: the offices that may call the runtime's /api (X-Office), each checked with the secret

secret.name: runtime_link
secret.purpose: signs every call between the platform and the runtime; each side keeps its own copy in its own instance

intake.about: an agent the owner approved from LARRYD's review queue (one .larryd file) becomes a locker folder <folder>/<card key>/ (the host's place command)
